verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.defaultSubtitle: Verification is optional — earn the Verified badge with an ID and selfie review. You can always do this later.
verify.subtitleVerifiedOnly: This owner accepts verified contacts only. Verify your identity to reach them.
verify.subtitleProfile: Verify your identity to earn the Verified badge — build trust and stand out. It takes about a minute.
verify.subtitleMyListings: Verify your identity to earn the badge — your listings rank higher.
verify.openingBody: You'll review consent, capture your document, and take a live selfie. The badge is granted only after staff review.
verify.why1: Build trust — owners and tenants know you're a genuine person.
verify.why2: Rank higher and get faster responses on your listings and enquiries.
verify.why3: Takes about a minute, one time — and it's completely optional.
verify.how1: Capture one supported ID document and a live selfie on your phone.
verify.how2: We read only the minimum fields needed to speed up staff review — never to auto-grant a badge.
verify.how3: A trained reviewer confirms the submission, then the Verified badge is issued.
verify.privacyBody1: Only trained reviewers can inspect your ID images. After review, the platform keeps only the last 4 digits, hashes, and review metadata needed for deduplication and audit.
verify.privacyBody2: Images are deleted seven days after a decision. This reduces casual misuse but is not fraud-proof or authoritative identity validation.
verify.footer: One verified person = one Verified badge

verify.bannerHeadline: Verify your identity to rank all your listings higher
verify.bannerBody: Verified owners appear above unverified ones and earn more buyer trust. It's optional and takes about a minute.
verify.overviewBody: Verify once with a document and selfie review to build trust, rank higher in search, and stand out to owners. Never required to browse or contact.
verify.buyerNudgeBody: This owner is verified — add your Verified badge to stand out from other enquiries.
